title: NRG_CE
description: NRG CE — Minecraft FPS Server. TACZ-powered competitive gameplay. Multiple modes, balanced guns, fair play.
body:
#                                _**"弹火逐风，局局新章，一枪一念定山河"**_




厌倦了堆砌一堆枪械包却没机会挨个爽玩？手动选枪又费劲还破坏公平？

这款·颠覆性的·随机枪战整合包直接拿捏痛点！

自动解锁随机枪械，海量武器轮着体验，公平竞技 + 全枪畅玩，游戏体验直接拉满！

## [_**=--核心亮点--=**_]

500+款 来自20款枪械附属包的枪械；

600+种 可自由改装的配件；

50+种 不同的近战武器；

10种 拥有不同技能的干员；

10种 现代化的载具；

10张 精致的比赛地图；

14种 独特的比赛条目；



所有枪械均可局内动态改装；

全方面毫秒级高度随机；

一键管理比赛，操作简单容易上手；

## [_**=--独家优势--=_**]

核心功能由完全原创的数据包实现，稳定性与效率兼备；

全方面强劲优化，极致轻量化设计，核显稳定300帧+，低配玩家友好；

开放核心功能修改权限，高度自定义；代码含完整注释，并提供配套修改教程。

提供可直接下载服务器核心，简单修改后即可一键开服；

## [_**=--游戏玩法&比赛流程--=_**]

自动将所有玩家分队（仅团队比赛）。

自动通知玩家比赛的信息，如比赛地点和模式。玩家的目标是在一定时间内尽可能淘汰更多的对手或赢得更多回合。

随机传送玩家到比赛场地。每名玩家的出生点都是实时变化的。

所有玩家重生后将获得3秒无敌效果，100点血量，并获得随机武器与配件。

在比赛过程中，每2分钟玩家将获得自选干员的技能物品。

比赛结束后，自动排名，并公布结果。迅速初始化所有地图，等待下一场比赛。







#                                _**“Bullets and flames chase the wind; every match is a new chapter; every shot and every decision shapes the battlefield”**_




Tired of stockpiling a pile of weapon packs but never getting the chance to enjoy them all? Is manually selecting weapons a hassle that undermines fairness?

This ·revolutionary· random shooter bundle tackles these pain points head-on!

Automatically unlock random weapons, cycle through a massive arsenal, enjoy fair competition + full access to every gun—take your gaming experience to the max!

## [_**=--Key Highlights--=**_]

500+ weapons from 20 gun packs;

600+ freely customizable attachments;

50+ different melee weapons;

10 Operators with unique skills;

10 modern vehicles;

10 intricately designed match maps;

14 unique match modes;



All weapons can be dynamically customized in-game;

Comprehensive, millisecond-level randomization;

One-click match management—simple and easy to use;

## [_**=--Exclusive Advantages--=_**]

Core features are implemented via a completely original data package, ensuring both stability and efficiency;

Comprehensive optimization and ultra-lightweight design, delivering a stable 300+ FPS on integrated graphics, making it friendly for players with lower-end systems;

Open access to core feature modification permissions for high customization; code includes full comments and comes with accompanying modification tutorials.

Provides a directly downloadable server core; launch the server with a single click after simple modifications;

## [_**=--Gameplay & Match Flow--=_**]

Automatically divides all players into teams (team matches only).

Automatically notifies players of match details, such as location and mode. The objective is to eliminate as many opponents as possible or win the most rounds within a set time limit.

Players are randomly teleported to the match arena. Each player’s spawn point changes in real time.

Upon respawning, all players gain 3 seconds of invincibility, 100 HP, and a random weapon with attachments.

During the match, players will receive skill items for their chosen operator every 2 minutes.

After the match ends, rankings are automatically generated and results are announced. All maps are quickly reset, ready for the next match.
